title: Describe What You See: Images, Diagrams and Microscopes
objective: Students describe visual biology information without memorizing a long paragraph.
context: Picture notes: a round pond; two small frogs at the edge; three long leaves in the centre.

items.prompt: Say what you see using “There are”.
items.hint: Use a number and a plural noun.

items.answer: Frogs are at the edge. Leaves are in the centre.
items.hint: Choose words such as in, on, and at.

items.prompt: Tell a partner one fact about shape and one about size.
items.answer: The pond is round. The frogs are small.
items.hint: Look for words that tell you how something looks.
